digest.component_or_area: Jira family adapter seam and Data Center backend integration
propositions: Three independent copies of the local-to-Jira status and priority maps exist today with drift (two copies agree on deleted->Done, ACLI copy omits it), creating a maintenance liability and preventing unified field mapping.

PR #120's separate DC adapter forks six symbols from jira/backend.py as private imports without a contract, creating a de facto Jira family layer with no structural boundary to prevent Cloud changes from silently breaking DC.

Cloud and DC differ on three axes (REST v2 with wiki/plain text vs v3 with ADF, PAT bearer auth vs ACLI subprocess, name-based vs accountId identity) requiring parameterized contracts rather than duplication or separate implementations.

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) are loaded by file path via dynamic loader and cannot relocate without breaking the loader, but their contents can be edited to import from jira_family rather than moving the files.

The DC probe classifier hardcodes Cloud workflow state names (Resolved, Done, Cancelled) and would silently misclassify a self-hosted DC issue as PRESENT_FILTERED when resolved under different names, requiring the resolved-status set as a parameter.

Self-hosted DC frequently runs over plain HTTP inside corporate networks, putting ticket bodies and PAT on the wire in cleartext unless the backend requires https with explicit allow_insecure override and enforces certificate verification even when the override is set.
